meta.title: Review365: Google Maps health check report
meta.description: Free check of your Google Maps profile against the factors Google uses to rank businesses — see what to fix to climb local search.
meta.reportTitle: Review365: Google Maps health check for {name}

search.heading: Profile check for
search.pitch: See exactly where your store's Google Maps profile is losing customers.
placeholders: Paste your store's Google Maps link
search.perkCriteria: Checks the factors Google ranks on
search.howtoSummary: Where do I find the Google Maps link?
search.howtoStep1: Open Google Maps and find your store.
search.howtoStep2: Choose Copy link and paste it in the box above.

errors.invalidLink: That link doesn't look right — we need the Google Maps link of a single place (maps.app.goo.gl/…, google.com/maps/place/…)
errors.failed: We couldn't fetch the store's data — please try again later
errors.notFound: No store found for this link — check that it points to a single place
errors.offline: Connection lost — check your network and try again
errors.expired: This report has expired or does not exist — paste a Google Maps link to run the diagnosis again.

overview.lead: Review365: Google Maps health check for

blurbs.basic: Complete and accurate core business details.

name.title: Business name
name.desc: No unrelated keywords stuffed into the business name

category.title: Primary category
category.desc: The primary category that best fits your services is set

description.title: Business description
description.desc: An accurate business description is set
description.fix: Write a 250–750 character description with your service and area keywords

address.title: Address
address.desc: Province, street address and building name are set correctly
address.fix: Add the full house number, street, ward/district and province

hours.title: Business hours configured
hours.fix: Set opening hours for all 7 days

hoursAccuracy.title: Business hours accuracy
hoursAccuracy.desc: Business hours match the store's real hours

website.title: Website
website.desc: The store's website link is configured
website.fix: Link a website (or landing page) to the profile

phone.title: Phone number
phone.desc: The store's phone number is set

postFreq.title: Posting frequency
postFreq.desc: At least one post every week
postFreq.fix: Post at least once a week (offers, new items, events)

postKw.title: Keywords in the latest post
postKw.desc: The latest post includes the target keywords

photoCount.title: Number of photos
photoCount.desc: The profile has 10 or more photos (customer photos included)
photoCount.fix: Upload more photos of the space, products and team

photoFreq.title: Photo upload frequency
photoFreq.desc: The owner added the latest photo within the past month

logo.title: Logo and cover photo
logo.desc: A logo and cover photo are set

avg.title: Average rating
avg.desc: A star rating of 4.4 or higher
avg.fix: Invite happy customers to leave a review

count.title: Number of reviews

replyKw.title: Review replies

replyRate.title: Review reply rate
